crossRefs.note: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is…
That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by…

translations.web: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.
translations.bsb: But if the animal was actually stolen from the neighbor, he must make restitution to the owner.
translations.kjv: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner
translations.asv: But if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
